desc: 三条装素色缎档毛圈面巾，窗光棚拍做实毛圈与包边
leaf: 素色缎档毛圈面巾三条装
name: 素色缎档毛圈面巾三条装款

shots.intent: 首屏用透帘窗光与三叠花色的真实毛圈质感承接流量，一眼讲清「这是一组素色缎档毛圈面巾」，把柔软亲肤的第一印象做实而不是靠形容词。
shots.textZone: 上方安静带：朱红小旗「{callout_1}」，主标题「{selling_point_1}」两行带一段朱红短下划条，其下一行细字「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 干净的暖瓷白棚拍单品图，一次看清折叠法、毛圈高度与缎档位置，负责搜索结果页的一眼点击与主图合规。
shots.textZone: 右下角一枚极小暖瓷卡「{callout_1}」，画面内不加其它文字

shots.intent: 同机位俯视分屏放大「薄巾擦完水珠还挂在面上、巾体湿闷成团」的日常痛点，把毛圈吸水与快干的需求逼出来。
shots.textZone: 顶部 #2B2B2D 通栏主标「{selling_point_2}」带朱红短下划条，两格底角各一枚 6px 微圆角细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 掠射微距把每一圈棉毛圈的立起高度、均匀度与蓬松感做成看得见的证据，正面回答「毛圈到底厚不厚、是不是印花假毛圈」。
shots.textZone: 上方留白带：小标题「{selling_point_3}」与其下两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，实线引线连到毛圈，末端 4px 空心圆环

shots.intent: 贴地掠射把缎档的立体织带结构和短边方格包边走线一次看清，用工艺细节承接源页的缎档与包边两个卖点屏。
shots.textZone: 下方留白：小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，实线引线分别指向织带与包边

shots.intent: 把一杯水倒在铺平的毛圈面上，用看得见的入水瞬间解释吸水机制，替掉源页那张与产品无关的蓝色分层示意图。
shots.textZone: 左侧细留白：竖排小标题「{selling_point_5}」与其下三枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，实线引线指向湿区边缘，示意箭头只画在表面

shots.intent: 实景把面巾放回浴室日常：台面叠放、挂杆垂挂、盆边搭一条，五枚场合标签沿用源页的场景屏，扩大使用人群。
shots.textZone: 右侧一列五枚 6px 微圆角细字标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_5}」，只写场合不写功效；右上角小标题「{selling_point_6}」

shots.intent: 三格正俯把实际供应的三个花色一次排开，让买家按浴室配色先认领款式，替掉源页只靠叠放暗示花色的做法。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；三枚卡片底缘各一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，不写尺寸数字与克重

shots.intent: 同一光位下的侧视剖面把本款的毛圈高度、垂坠与素薄巾放一起比，替买家完成值不值的判断，不靠形容词。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_8}」，两格底角各一枚微圆角小标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 把毛圈、缎档、包边、花色四项看点与一张诚实的通用参数表摊开，用透明结构降风险，而不是搬源页的空洞背书。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_9}」；四枚圆环图标各配短标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_4}」；下方参数表行名为品类／织面／档边／边口／规格五个通用词，数值一律为占位符「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位与光位收口，把整页情绪落回自家浴室窗边的三叠花色，再给一个明确的选色咨询动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一暖瓷留白：主标「{selling_point_1}」带朱红短下划条，其下一枚 6px 微圆角按钮，填色 #D9412E，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a bright wash corner with one sheer-curtained window behind, a pale limestone ledge #E7E2D9 and soft out-of-focus window greenery #DDE4D6 as the only depth; a seamless warm porcelain studio sweep #F7F5F1 with one matte pale-stone plinth #E7E2D9 and one clear acrylic riser for every packshot, macro and comparison screen; and one flat deep charcoal board #2B2B2D carrying warm porcelain cards #FDFCF9 for the comparison, variant, scene-tab and specification layouts; every screen holds one clean copy zone, near-square tabs with a 6px micro-radius, one 1px vermilion #D9412E keyline on the layout screens and never busy decor, never tiled bathroom walls with grout grids, never a marble-vein feature wall
style.direction: bright high-key bath-textile daylight commerce: airy sheer-curtained washcorner and warm porcelain studio sweeps carrying a charcoal infographic board and a vermilion flag accent, loop-pile macro evidence first, rather than a cold clinical blue hygiene set, a rustic bamboo-and-linen zen spa, or a saturated luxury hotel-gold bathroom
style.iconSystem: 0.9pt single-line hairline pictograms seated inside 2px-outlined circles with one solid vermilion #D9412E dot at the upper-left rim, solid hairline leader lines closing on a 4px open ring, and 6px micro-radius near-square chips for the tab labels, maximum five per screen; no dotted-leader chains, no hexagonal or shield frames, no corner brackets, no filled grey discs, no 3D badges, no seals or stamps
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key diffuse daylight at 5500-5700K from one large sheer-curtained source in from camera front-left, plus a wide white bounce from camera right that keeps the shadow side open and legible; one soft open contact shadow directly under the object, never a hard window rake with visible mullion bars, never a long dramatic rake across the pile, never a 6800K cool blue hygiene cast and never a 3000K warm spa-lamp grade; macro screens add one low grazing ribbon from camera left held at 5500K so each cotton loop casts its own micro-shadow and the pile reads as real relief, with the satin dobby band returning one narrow controlled highlight only

style.presentationRules: the towel is the product and the wash corner is scenery: the same loop height, loop density, pile direction, fold count, border-band placement and hem stitch repeat in every frame, and the same three colourways in the same stack order whenever more than one is shown, powder blue #A9C7E2 uppermost, cream white #F2EEE6 middle, wheat oatmeal #D8C08C below; the pile is never rendered as a flat weave in one screen and as deep terry in another; folded towels sit grounded with a real soft contact shadow and never hover above the ledge; when a towel hangs it hangs over a rail with believable fall and one natural fold, never pinned flat; window verticals, curtain edges, rail lines and the border band stay straight and corrected; the slight 3/4 stack angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one bathroom; any person is anonymous, cropped above the jaw or turned away, and a face is never shown being rubbed dry
style.surfaceSystem: warm porcelain sweep #F7F5F1, pale limestone ledge #E7E2D9, matte pale-stone plinth, clear acrylic riser, matte porcelain cards #FDFCF9, one pale cotton-twill hanging rail #DCD3C4 and one washed beech shelf #D9C9AE; the product renders exactly as supplied, an even dense upright cotton loop-pile terry face with a soft matte hand, one raised corded stripe pair and one wider satin dobby band near one end, a fine checked hem stitch across the short ends, matte loop pile on the reverse of the fold and no sheen anywhere except inside the satin band; no velour, no waffle or honeycomb weave, no printed-on pile illusion, no microfibre suede look, no plastic sheen
style.typography: one soft rounded-terminal humanist gothic family for Chinese display headlines, set on a single baseline and closed by one short vermilion accent underline bar, the same family at regular weight for labels and in tabular figures for the specification block; headline 26-34pt, sub-line 14-16pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen copy under 50 characters; all Chinese in-image copy wrapped in 「」; no brush calligraphy, no serif or song-ti display, no handwritten script, no decorative English uppercase kicker lines and no translated subtitle rows
